Colophon

How this site was built, what it was built from, and what was and was not checked about it.

Build

One ledger file (content/ledger.yaml) is the only source of factual sentences. A Python 3 standard-library script validates it and writes static HTML to dist/. The build fails, and writes nothing, if a MEASURED entry lacks its metric, value, denominator, dataset, synthetic flag, system, date or evidence; if a KILLED entry lacks its criterion; if a BLOCKED entry lacks its blocker; if a LINKED entry lacks a tier-1 path with branch and SHA; or if any entry lacks as_of or "does not show". STALE is computed at build time.

No dependencies, no third-party requests, no fonts, no analytics, no cookies. Type is a system stack: Helvetica Neue / Arial for text, the platform monospace for data. Every page works without JavaScript; the only script filters the ledger table, and the same filters exist as plain pages. Served by Python's http.server bound to the loopback interface only.

Entries: 35 public (15 LINKED, 20 AUTHOR-REPORTED); 2 hidden by default and not published.

The site was assembled by an AI coding agent working from my repositories and notes, under rules that forbid inventing or rounding numbers. The ledger is the place to check it.

Not checked

  • Full W3C/Nu HTML validation: NOT RUN. no validator on this machine (no vnu, tidy or java); a stdlib structural check ran instead
  • Interactive keyboard traversal in a real browser: NOT RUN. no browser automation driver available without installing one; static keyboard checks ran instead
  • Screen-reader pass: NOT RUN. no screen reader automation available
  • Automated visual regression test: NOT RUN. none exists; instead the agent looked at headless-Edge screenshots (1280px dark and light, a 375px iframe for phone width) on 2026-11-20, which found and led to fixing a phone-width horizontal overflow; no human has reviewed the design
  • Re-running the source repos' own test suites: NOT RUN. repos are read-only for this build; running pytest/npm would write caches into them

Built 2026-11-20 from content/ledger.yaml. STALE = as_of older than 90 days at build time. Machine-readable: ledger.json.
